content.value_statement: Blockchain projects need secure architecture, tested contracts, and clear deployment plans. This skill guides Web3 implementation across contracts, dApps, DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and enterprise chains.
actual_capabilities: Designs smart contract architectures for Solidity, Vyper, Rust, and related blockchain ecosystems.
Reviews common contract risks, including reentrancy, overflow, access control, and oracle issues.
Plans DeFi, NFT, DAO, wallet, and cross-chain application workflows.
Recommends Web3 frontend patterns using wallets, authentication, gasless transactions, and onboarding flows.
Defines testing, fuzzing, formal verification, monitoring, and deployment checklists.
Maps enterprise blockchain use cases to identity, supply chain, custody, compliance, and reporting needs.
limitations: It provides guidance and implementation plans, but it does not replace a professional smart contract audit.
It cannot guarantee protocol safety, token value, legal compliance, or successful mainnet operation.
It should not handle real seed phrases, private keys, recovery phrases, or custody credentials.
Network, framework, and regulatory details may require current documentation and legal review.

use_cases.title: Plan a Smart Contract Build
use_cases.description: Create contract architecture, security requirements, and test coverage before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review a Web3 Product Concept
use_cases.description: Evaluate wallet flows, chain selection, user risks, compliance needs, and operational tradeoffs.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Enterprise Blockchain Proposal
use_cases.description: Translate business requirements into network design, custody model, integration plan, and verification process.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner orientation for a new blockchain feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the blockchain architecture for my project. Include the chain choice, contracts, wallets, storage, and key security risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Contract System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a smart contract system for this feature. Include modules, permissions, upgrade strategy, events, tests, and deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Security Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this smart contract plan for security risks. Cover access control, reentrancy, oracle trust, upgrade risks, economics, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Chain Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-chain deployment plan. Include bridge assumptions, chain-specific constraints, verification steps, incident response, and rollback options.

output_examples.input: Design a DAO treasury system with token voting and time-locked execution.
output: A contract architecture with governance, timelock, treasury, roles, and proposal lifecycle components.
A security checklist covering vote manipulation, quorum design, privileged actions, and emergency controls.
A deployment plan with testnet validation, monitoring, documentation, and audit readiness steps.

output_examples.input: Review a DeFi lending protocol concept before development.
output: A risk review for collateral factors, liquidation logic, oracle design, pause controls, and admin permissions.
A testing plan for market stress, edge cases, invariant checks, fuzzing, and economic simulations.
A product note explaining user risks, operational limits, and launch requirements.

output_examples.input: Plan wallet integration for a Next.js dApp.
output: A frontend integration plan for wallet connection, supported chains, session handling, and fallback states.
A user flow review for onboarding, transaction confirmation, error recovery, and gas messaging.
A security checklist for signature prompts, phishing resistance, and safe transaction previews.

best_practices: Start with threat modeling, permissions, invariants, and failure modes before writing contracts.
Use audited libraries, explicit tests, fuzzing, and formal verification for high-value logic.
Keep private keys outside prompts, repositories, logs, tickets, and shared workspaces.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy unaudited contracts that control valuable assets or irreversible permissions.
Do not rely on a single oracle, admin wallet, bridge, or custodian without clear risk controls.
Do not paste seed phrases, private keys, signing keys, or production credentials into any assistant.

faq.question: Can this skill write smart contract code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help design and implement contracts, tests, and deployment steps for common Web3 patterns.

faq.question: Does this replace a smart contract audit?
faq.answer: No. It supports preparation and review, but independent security audit is still required for production funds.

faq.question: Which blockchain ecosystems does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Ethereum, EVM chains, Solana, Cosmos, NEAR, Polkadot, Cardano, Algorand, Hyperledger, and Bitcoin Lightning topics.

faq.question: Can it help with DeFi and NFT products?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers AMMs, lending, yield systems, marketplaces, royalties, token standards, and cross-chain asset flows.

faq.question: Should I provide private keys for deployment help?
faq.answer: No. Never share private keys, seed phrases, recovery phrases, or signing credentials in prompts.

faq.question: Can it help with enterprise blockchain work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan private networks, custody flows, supply chain tracking, identity, compliance, and integration requirements.
